Trackers

Clocks, countdowns and timers for the whole adventure. On the GM Screen each one gets a Start button that adds it to the Trackers tool.

Scenes
Travel

Legs of the journey: where from and to, how far, who leads the way, mishaps and encounters on the road. On the GM Screen a leg's travel time can start as a Ticks tracker.

Factions

Groups with their own goals. Each faction's clock is a row of boxes: say what fills a box and what happens when the last one fills. On the GM Screen the clock gets a Start button that adds it to the Trackers tool.

Vehicles

The crew's vehicles and the ones they meet. On the GM Screen a vehicle goes to the combat tracker like any foe, its hull as the damage track.
